healthcare_provider_setting.label: Healthcare-provider setting
healthcare_provider_setting.value: Hospice provider (VITAS), delivering end-of-life care mainly in patients' homes and facilities; Roto-Rooter plumbing is non-healthcare

payer_revenue_mix.label: Payer revenue mix
payer_revenue_mix.value: VITAS revenue predominantly Medicare, with smaller Medicaid and commercial insurance shares

payment_reimbursement_model.label: Payment / reimbursement model
payment_reimbursement_model.value: Medicare hospice daily (per diem) capitated rates by level of care, subject to annual caps

setting_specific_capacity.label: Setting-specific capacity
setting_specific_capacity.value: VITAS operates 59 hospice programs across 15 states and the District of Columbia

patient_acuity_case_mix.label: Patient acuity / case mix
patient_acuity_case_mix.value: Terminally ill patients, mostly routine home care, with some higher-acuity continuous home care and inpatient levels

notes: Evidence covers the VITAS hospice segment only in part; payer mix, volume and quality are not on the pages, and the payer and reimbursement details come from general knowledge.
